changed_surfaces.purpose: Add the versioned workflow business model for nodes, edges, variables, form bindings, positions and action policies.
Adapt schemaVersion 1, schemaVersion 2 and legacy steps JSON into the common model.
Validate graph topology, gateway defaults, assignee sources, approval modes, variables, expressions, bindings and action policies with structured errors.
Compile the business model to Flowable BpmnModel and BPMN 2.0 XML with stable node mappings.
Add enterprise model and BPMN compiler tests while preserving the existing validator tests.

commands.salient_output: Initial new test graph exposed an invalid default-path topology; no production compiler failure was observed.

local_checks.evidence: Valid graph with condition gateway, default branch, parallel split/join, role approval, org-owner approval, percent approval, multi-instance collection and form binding accepted.
Compiled XML contains exclusiveGateway, parallelGateway and multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics; Flowable BpmnXMLConverter parsed it back successfully.
limitations: Repository deployment is intentionally deferred to T3.

local_checks.evidence: Legacy steps and schemaVersion=1 definitions are adapted and existing four validator tests remain green.

diff_summary: Added schemaVersion=2 business model and adapter.
Added structured graph and configuration validation.
Added Flowable BPMN compiler with stable node mapping.
Preserved schemaVersion=1 and legacy steps compatibility.
Excluded serviceTask and messageEvent generation by design.

invariants_checked.evidence: Legacy adapter and existing validator tests pass.

invariants_checked.invariant: Unsupported service/message nodes are not introduced
invariants_checked.evidence: Compiler test asserts XML has no serviceTask or messageEvent.

invariants_checked.invariant: BPMN node ids remain traceable to designer ids
invariants_checked.evidence: Compiler returns a mapping for every source node and parsed XML preserves mapped ids.

disturbances.event: Initial compiler test graph reused one approval node for mutually exclusive and parallel paths.
disturbances.response: Corrected the test graph to use a separate default path and reran the full module test suite.

unresolved_items: Flowable repository deployment, runtime assignee resolution and approval actions are T3.
